text:
alex: customer PROD report - toolcall failing with json schema error, ticket #7892. sending repro and raw error below

alex: curl + response (redacted)
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tools/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"charge.invoice.create","input":{"amount":"100","currency":"USD","billing_profile":{},"debug":true}}'
```

alex: response (400)
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "json_schema_validation_failed",
    "message": "additionalProperties not allowed: debug",
    "details": ["billing_profile.id: missing required field", "amount: expected number but got string"]
  }
}
```

sophia: can you confirm this is REST request (not SDK) and which SDK version? also any request_id from the response headers? :thinking:

alex: REST. sdk not involved. response headers show x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d. using customer-prod key.

jamie: tagging @kevin for eng help, assigning severity P2 for now. any repro in a sandbox?

kevin: I can look. quick q: tool name charge.invoice.create - is that new schema? did customer recently update billing_profile shape? also that "debug" property is unexpected. can you paste full raw body (not shell-escaped) and the server-side validation trace?

alex: full body below (raw)
```json
{"tool":"charge.invoice.create","input":{"amount":"100","currency":"USD","billing_profile":{},"debug":true}}
```

alex: validation log excerpt:
```
ValidationError: additionalProperties found [debug] at /input
  at validateObject (validator.js:142:27)
  at validateProperty (validator.js:89:12)
  details: [ { path: '/input/billing_profile', error: 'required property id missing' }, { path: '/input/amount', error: 'type mismatch: expected number' } ]
```

oncall-bot: Escalation created: ESCL-2026-453. Linking ticket #7892 -> ESCL-2026-453 :rotating_light:

sophia: thanks. alex, two tracks: (1) immediate customer workaround: send amount as number and remove debug flag; (2) eng longfix: accept string-number coercion for amount and ignore unknown top-level props under input for this tool for a short window. can you try the workaround and confirm?

alex: tried with amount as number and removed debug -> request accepted, no 400. customer confirmed. but they need longer-term fix (integration sends debug by default).

kevin: ok will prototype a conservative schema-lenient shim in the runtime layer to coerce numbers and drop unknown properties for charge.invoice.create only. will add a flag behind runtime feature-flag and run canary for 1% of traffic to Dedicated. will also add a regression test to the tool schema CI.

kevin: plan: 1) add coercion for amount (string->number) + drop additionalProperties on input for this tool (2) add logging metric for coerced requests (3) 24h canary -> roll to 100% if no regressions.

jamie: please include the x-request-id and ticket mapping in commit message. set up rollback runbook. :white_check_mark:

kevin: creating PR now, will post link. if someone from infra can confirm no latency impact from the shim when enabled?

alex: adding notes to ticket #7892 and customer slack. thanks all.
